content.title: CACI (NYSE:CACI) Misses Q4 CY2025 Revenue Estimates
content.summary: Defense, intelligence, and IT solutions provider CACI International (NYSE:CACI) fell short of the markets revenue expectations in Q4 CY2025, but sales rose 5.7% year on year to $2.22 billion. On the other hand, the company’s outlook for the full year was close to analysts’ estimates with revenue guided to $9.4 billion at the midpoint. Its non-GAAP profit of $6.81 per share was 4.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
